1. Purpose

Learn how to efficiently manage your financial workflows by creating a new customer order and processing its approval within JobTread. This guide walks you through setting up budgets and payment schedules to keep your project documentation organized and accurate.

2. Scope

Define the teams, locations, systems, activities, and situations covered. Note exclusions, if any.

3. Definitions & Acronyms

Define specialized terms, abbreviations, and role names used in this procedure.

4. Roles & Responsibilities

Role / Team Responsibility
Process owner Accountable for process performance and SOP accuracy
Procedure performer Carries out the steps and records required evidence
Reviewer / approver Checks accuracy, risk, and readiness for release

7. Procedure

Write the process as numbered, actionable steps. Use one primary action per step and identify the responsible role, required inputs, and expected result.

1. Sign In to Job Tread.

2. Select the Job to work on from Active Jobs.

3. This will take you to the job dashboard.

4. Locate the newly uploaded contract.

5. Open to view and make a note of the contract Price

6. Also take note of the down payment amount.

7. Close the Contract File.

8. Navigate to the Budget Tab.

9. Enter the Contract Price into Extended price on the Jacuzzi Project

line

10. Save changes.

11. Select the line item with the contract amount in it.

12. Side menu will pop up. Click New Document with Selected.

13. Underneath customer orders, Select: Customer Order (Internal)

14. Click create.

15. Modify the payment schedule is down payment is anything but $1000.

Do this by clicking on the payment schedule tab.

16. Adjust your down payment amount to match the contract.

17. Click Save.

18. Click the Approve button to solidify the order.

19. Make sure to uncheck the notify button so that the customer

does not see this as it is an internal document.

20. Now click update.

21. The job is now approved.

22. Go to the documents tab.

23. And you will see pre - populated. Invoices that correspond with the

contract.

24. Go to the dashboard.

25. Back on the Dashboard tab you will see the budget snapshot updated

with contract price.

26. Go to Job Schedule

27. Check off contract approved.

28. Check off set budget tab with contract pricing.

29. It's time to make the first customer call. Click on that task.

30. Review discussion points on the task checklist and call customer.

-Welcome them to the Production Stage of the project.

-Review the timeline and process for the production dept.

-Verify Contract start and completion dates

-Let them know what our tentative install date actually is

31. Customer call is complete. Add call notes to message board and check

off task as complete.
